import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import boto3
from langchain_core.tools import tool
s3_client = boto3.client('s3')

@tool
def archive_and_upload_workout_export(export_file_path: str, archive_directory: str, bucket_name: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
    source_path = Path(export_file_path)
    archive_path = Path(archive_directory)
    archive_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Remove older archived copies of the same export to avoid accumulating duplicates
    for stale_file in archive_path.glob(f'*_{source_path.name}'):
        if stale_file.is_file():
            stale_file.unlink()
    timestamp_text = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    archived_file_name = f'{timestamp_text}_{source_path.name}'
    destination_path = archive_path / archived_file_name
    shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination_path))
    object_key = f'users/{user_id}/workout_exports/{archived_file_name}'
    file_size_bytes = destination_path.stat().st_size
    s3_client.upload_file(Filename=str(destination_path), Bucket=bucket_name, Key=object_key, ExtraArgs={'ServerSideEncryption': 'AES256'})
    return {'archived_path': str(destination_path), 'bucket': bucket_name, 'key': object_key, 'size_bytes': file_size_bytes}
